name: iOS IMA DAI verification
description: Staging verification for Google IMA Dynamic Ad Insertion tracking. Replace accountIds 0 and dai-YYYY-MM-DD before creating.

widgets.title: Scenario results (requests = starts = ends, breakStarts = breakEnds)

nrqlQueries.query: FROM VideoAdAction SELECT filter(count(*), WHERE actionName = 'AD_REQUEST') AS requests, filter(count(*), WHERE actionName = 'AD_START') AS starts, filter(count(*), WHERE actionName = 'AD_END') AS ends, filter(count(*), WHERE actionName = 'AD_BREAK_START') AS breakStarts, filter(count(*), WHERE actionName = 'AD_BREAK_END') AS breakEnds, filter(count(*), WHERE adStreamType IS NULL) AS missingStreamType WHERE testRun = 'dai-YYYY-MM-DD' FACET scenario SINCE 1 day ago

FROM VideoAdAction SELECT filter(count(*), WHERE actionName = 'AD_REQUEST') AS '1 request', filter(count(*), WHERE actionName = 'AD_START') AS '2 start', filter(count(*), WHERE actionName = 'AD_QUARTILE' AND adQuartile = 1) AS '3 Q1', filter(count(*), WHERE actionName = 'AD_QUARTILE' AND adQuartile = 2) AS '4 Q2', filter(count(*), WHERE actionName = 'AD_QUARTILE' AND adQuartile = 3) AS '5 Q3', filter(count(*), WHERE actionName = 'AD_END') AS '6 end' WHERE testRun = 'dai-YYYY-MM-DD' SINCE 1 day ago
FROM VideoErrorAction SELECT count(*) WHERE testRun = 'dai-YYYY-MM-DD' AND actionName = 'AD_ERROR' FACET scenario, errorDomain, errorCode, errorMessage, adStreamType SINCE 1 day ago

widgets.title: Ad break pairing (unpaired should be 0 for completed runs)

nrqlQueries.query: FROM (FROM VideoAdAction SELECT filter(count(*), WHERE actionName = 'AD_BREAK_START') AS s, filter(count(*), WHERE actionName = 'AD_BREAK_END') AS e WHERE testRun = 'dai-YYYY-MM-DD' FACET adBreakId LIMIT MAX SINCE 1 day ago) SELECT count(*) AS breaks, filter(count(*), WHERE s != e) AS unpaired

FROM VideoAdAction SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE adDuration IS NOT NULL) AS duration, percentage(count(*), WHERE adTitle IS NOT NULL) AS title, percentage(count(*), WHERE adCreativeId IS NOT NULL) AS creativeId, percentage(count(*), WHERE adPosition IS NOT NULL) AS position WHERE testRun = 'dai-YYYY-MM-DD' AND actionName = 'AD_START' SINCE 1 day ago
FROM VideoAdAction SELECT count(*) WHERE testRun = 'dai-YYYY-MM-DD' AND actionName = 'AD_END' FACET adSkipped SINCE 1 day ago

FROM VideoAdAction SELECT count(*) WHERE actionName IN ('AD_REQUEST', 'AD_START', 'AD_QUARTILE', 'AD_END', 'AD_BREAK_START', 'AD_BREAK_END') FACET if(adStreamType IS NULL, 'CSAI', adStreamType), actionName SINCE 1 day ago
